blocks.text: This Marvel Studios Captain America Brave New World Flight Vision Mask is a role play toy kids 5 and up can use to dress up as Sam Wilson! Boys and girls can play as Captain America on his latest mission to save the world against a dangerous new nemesis. Flight Vision Mask features eye lens that can slide up or down and includes a stretchy back strap to comfortably fit most kids 5 and up. This Captain America toy makes a great Marvel gift for any occasion, and can also be a fun accessory for Captain America and super hero Halloween costumes! Look for other exciting action figures, role play toys, and playsets inspired by Marvel Studios Captain America Brave New World. (Each sold separately. Subject to availability.) Copyright MARVEL. items.value: This roleplay toy is designed and inspired by Marvel Studios' latest film, Captain America Brave New World

items.label: POP-UP LENS FEATURE
items.value: Slide pegs on either side of the mask to slide lens up and down

items.label: FITS MOST KIDS 5 AND UP
items.value: Captain America toy mask measures approximately 6.5 inches by 9 inches (16.5 cm by 22.9 cm) and includes a stretchy back strap

items.label: MARVEL GIFT FOR KIDS
items.value: Celebrate occasions and milestones by gifting the young Marvel fan in your life with this super hero mask!

items.label: WEAR WITH COSTUMES, TOO
items.value: Pretending to be Captain America can go beyond playtime! Add Flight Vision mask with Halloween costumes or super hero themed parties
